consequence: The promotion gate must re-derive the operating threshold per model from that model's own validation split, and the operating point must be specified as a target (a precision level, or a detection density) rather than a score. A threshold carried from a previous model version changes detection rates silently, and mAP will not show it.
finding: Score thresholds do not transfer between training runs. Three runs of an identical config produced max scores of 0.375, 0.223 and 0.260, so a fixed threshold cuts each distribution at a different place in its own range. Precision at 0.05 varied by sd 0.132 against mAP's 0.0066.
